{{Otheruses|Refugee}}
[[File:Refugee_Zabrak_EV.png|thumb|right|250px|A pair of Zabrak refugees]]
A '''refugee''' was an individual who was forced to flee their home or native land due to disaster or conflict such as [[List of battles/Legends|war]] or [[Speciecide|genocide]].

==History==
Massive refugee populations were the often result of pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] wars, including the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Great Galactic War]], and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While many refugees elected to simply move to a less dangerous region of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], as seen on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], many others were forced to flee their [[Planet/Legends|planets]] altogether. Such mass exoduses were seen during the Mandalorian Wars, when the surface of [[Serroco]] was blasted into [[Glass/Legends|glass]] craters by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear warheads]]. On worlds that were common hosts to refugee populations, specific regions became dedicated to their housing and shelter. The [[Refugee Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] served this purpose, as did the [[Old Galactic Market]] and [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Underworld]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] reign, the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] aided refugees fleeing from violence or coping with disaster.

[[File:Alderaan_Refugees.png|thumb|right|200px|''Alderaan refugees'']]
The refugees of Nar Shaddaa were a loosely knit group of asylum seekers from the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War. Led&mdash;unofficially&mdash;by [[Hussef]], they were civilians and ex-soldiers the Republic, Mandalorians and Sith. They were forced to live in horrendous and cramped conditions in a small maze of cargo containers and prefabricated structures in the Refugee Sector of Nar Shaddaa, and were constantly harried by the exploitative schemes of the [[Exchange]] and the aggressive Serroco thugs.

When the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] visited the Refugee Sector in her search for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zez-Kai Ell]] in [[3951 BBY]], she helped the struggling refugees greatly by "persuading" both factions to give the refugees more living space, as well as aiding several of the refugees with their individual problems.

A [[Painting/Legends|painting]] titled ''[[Alderaan Refugees]]''<ref name="CGP">{{StoryCite|story=Celestia Galactica Photografica|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>&mdash;created after [[104 ABY]]<ref name="104 ABY">"[[Celestia Galactica Photografica]]" was included in ''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: Legacy Vol. 4]]'', which describes the stories it contains as taking place more than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. That film took place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', meaning that all [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] in "Celestia Galactica Photografica," including ''Alderaan Refugees'', must have been created after [[104 ABY]].</ref>&mdash;depicted a variety of refugees on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="CGP" />
